{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Lucilla |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Sometimes, it feels a little strange when you call me "Professor." Feels like since you enrolled, I've been the one taking instruction. In any case, glad to have you around, {{Rover}}. Or should I say, "Professor {{Rover}}"? |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = Seeing you takes me back to my Pioneer Association days. Oh, the anticipation of setting foot on one strange land after another. Sometimes you'd stumble onto something wonderful. More often? Brutal challenges. Absurd misadventures. Lying flat on your back in camp, staring up at the stars, too exhausted to move... What do you think would cross your mind? Who would you think of? |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = When I first joined the Pioneer Association, it was pure rebellion. A way to spite my mother's plans. A little "self-sabotage" just to get under her skin. "Look," I wanted to say, "your carefully cultivated protege just joined an organization with zero political capital." Feels arrogant now, looking back. She raised me too well. Made me just like her... |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Coming to Startorch Academy was mostly by chance. I was first dispatched to Lahai-Roi for an extended expedition. Then one thing led to another, and I was reassigned to the Spacetrek Collective, eventually ending up here at the Academy. At first, they wanted me to use my Forte to trace ancient memories buried in Exostrider material. But how was a small life form such as myself ever to resonate with an alien civilization? |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I left that cold home. Left the New Federation. Left the Pioneer Association, too. Back then, I was just running for the sake of running. I loathed where I had come from so much that I tried to erase my memories of it. But you can't erase who you are... I thought the Academy would be another stop on the road. Then the views here took hold of me. And now, when I look back, all I see is them. |vo_02_01_title = Lucilla's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Busy afternoons on the first day of the semester. Hosting orientations, listening to reports, and delivering speeches at ceremonies. Then heading straight back to my office, lying face down on the cold desk, and listening to the little gremlins chattering and laughing away outside. Those are my favorite moments. |vo_02_02_title = Lucilla's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = I swear, the new jokes and memes around campus are evolving faster than I can keep up... |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Burnt cookies, soggy instant noodles, desserts where someone confused salt with sugar... If they made it for me, I love it. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = I like to think I'm quite open-minded about how each department runs things. But, how shall I put this... Sometimes I do feel the cafeteria's canned foods are a bit of a letdown. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = My dream now is just to see all my students' dreams come true. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = That camera, or rather that gun, has always existed in my memories. It seemed to have been with me ever since I awakened my Forte. Was it a present from someone? Or is it a "gift" from my memories? I can't quite remember. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = I have to admit, being editor-in-chief, a researcher, and President all at the same time probably means I didn't escape her plans for me. Which is all the more reason for me to be the kind of President students adore and bigwigs can't stand. Perhaps this is my "rebellious phase." |vo_04_01_title = About [[Hiyuki]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Hiyuki.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = You, me, and Hiyuki. If I may, I'd like to presume we're "cut from the same cloth." Each of us had our reasons for starting down the path we're on now. Difference is, I journey to stay, whereas you and Hiyuki... |vo_04_01_mention = Hiyuki |vo_04_02_title = About [[Aemeath]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Aemeath.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Behind that lovely smile is pure steel. I feel inspired just hearing her voice—Heh, see? You're a better teacher than I am! |vo_04_02_mention = Aemeath |vo_04_03_title = About [[Luuk Herssen]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Luuk Herssen.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = He's got just a few too many mysteries for a doctor... But as a colleague, his skills speak for themselves. And that's what I trust. |vo_04_03_mention = Luuk Herssen |vo_04_04_title = About [[Sigrika]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Sigrika.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = She's just the cutest, isn't she? Pure, honest, trying so hard to carry the weight of the world on those tiny shoulders. Breaks my heart. But given my position, even a gentle pat on the cheek would likely only make her more anxious. |vo_04_04_mention = Sigrika |vo_04_05_title = About [[Denia]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Denia.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = She's kept it hidden so well, for so long. That just makes me blame myself and my heart ache for her more. |vo_04_05_mention = Denia |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy birthday, {{Rover}}.
As your instructor, I hope you've taken something from every challenge we've faced together. Experience. Strength. For a dream like yours, you can never be too prepared.
But as your friend, my selfish wish is that you'd let yourself live a little more freely. At least today on your birthday, step out of the shadows of the past and look toward the future! |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = I believe it's this one? ...How nice. |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = ...Yes, I'm here. Of course. Proceed as planned. Bye-bye. |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Hm...? |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Lucilla, President of Startorch Academy. What surprises do you have in store for me today? |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Life's a reel of memories. And memories? Life, recut. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Field work? Love it. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Practicum time, everyone. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Tell me there's no sweating involved. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = So it's my turn to be the student this time? |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = Never too old to learn! |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Slow and steady. Let's not bite off more than we can chew. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = You may not have memories of power, but you can always draw strength from memories. |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = Every challenge we've faced, every obstacle we've overcome, and every memory we've shared... All of it has become my strength. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Lucilla |language = en |basic_1_tx = Look at the camera! |basic_2_tx = Smile! |basic_3_tx = Say cheese! |basic_4_tx = Mm-hmm. |basic_5_tx = Not bad. |basic_6_tx = Aren't you photogenic! |resskill_1_tx = C'mon, get in the shot. |resskill_2_tx = Hold still. |resskill_3_tx = Huh? |resskill_4_tx = Oh, my! |resskill_5_tx = Perfect lighting! |resliberation_1_tx = Illusions of the past...
